Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, I attached a light-touch revision of the MAP that smooths the evaluation cadence and adds a short contingency lane for procurement delays. High level:

- Move final acceptance window from 2027-01-12 -> 2027-01-19 (one-week buffer)
- Add a parallel procurement checkpoint (Doc sign + security attestation) that can be executed by your procurement team independently of the engineering cutover
- Two contingency levers we can exercise if procurement slips: (1) staggered go-live with read-only pilot, (2) temporary extended support hours during cutover week

Attachments: OLV-117_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with lane-level owners), acceptance-window-proposal.pdf (one-page summary).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Your procurement confirms whether DocuSign sign-off can be done by 12/15.
2) We run the pilot acceptance checklist on 12/22 if sign-off hits the earlier date.

If sign-off is likely later than 12/20, we escalate to a staggered go-live and I will request a limited credit for the extended pilot week.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15 min call if that helps.

— Ben
